name: Stone Golem
languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The stone golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

Actions.name: Force Bolt
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 ft. 22 (4d10) Force damage.

Actions.name: Ground Slam (1/Day)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the stone golem. *Failure:* 35 (10d6) Bludgeoning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Traits.name: Weeping Ground
Traits.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 17, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the stone golem. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.
Traits.expresses: weeping channels of blessed force from carved eyes

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The stone golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Bonus Actions.name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.text: The stone golem casts the *Slow* spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

lore: Quarried stone was carved into a kneeling saint and sealed with a martyr's vigil to guard the quarry doors; now that its reliquary shrine lies broken, the Weeping Saint walks in search of the hands that broke it.

generation.userConcept: Stone Golem — carved as a weeping saint

clauses.text: Stone Golem — carved as a weeping saint

generation.cite: composition after Fire Giant (CR 9) — the giant ladder continues

immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
